Central 'C' shapes show more diffused, irregular edge geometries with lower contrast transitions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid high-intensity clusters; light-colored pixels are primarily concentrated in linear annular perimeters. dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the five most prominent annular structures in the upper-left and center-top regions form an irregular pentagonal geometry with varying internal angles and non-uniform relative distances.
